{
  "correction_rules": [
    "When sentiment is negative (≤ 0), reduce forecast by 5-10% to account for downward pressure.",
    "After a price spike (forecast > 75), apply a 10-15% downward correction to prevent overshoot.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast (e.g., 3-5 consecutive days), apply mean reversion by adjusting forecast toward recent 7-day average.",
    "For long-term forecasts (30d), if history shows strong downward trend, reduce forecast by 3-5% per week to reflect diminishing volatility.",
    "If sentiment is positive (> 0.3), increase forecast by 3-5% to reflect bullish momentum, but cap at 75% of 30d high.",
    "When forecast is significantly below true outcome (e.g., > 10% under), consider a 5% upward adjustment to avoid underestimation.",
    "For dates with sentiment history including 0.5 or higher, apply a 2-3% upward bias to reflect strong bullish sentiment."
  ]
}
